title_pt: 2º Lugar no Hackathon de Agricultura de Precisão e Digital — UIUC
title_en: 2nd Place at the Precision & Digital Agriculture Hackathon — UIUC
summary_pt: Como parte da equipe Confusion_Matrix, desenvolvemos um sistema de monitoramento de cochos utilizando análise de imagens e indicadores de confiabilidade de dados no John Deere Technology Innovation Center (Center for Digital Agriculture, UIUC). A solução auxilia produtores a avaliar o nível de confiança dos dados de sensores para melhores tomadas de decisão na produção animal.
summary_en: As part of team Confusion_Matrix, we developed a livestock trough monitoring system using image analysis and data reliability indicators at the John Deere Technology Innovation Center (Center for Digital Agriculture, UIUC). The solution helps producers assess the confidence level of sensor data for better decision-making in animal production systems.

title_pt: Doutorado Sanduíche pelo PDSE/CAPES na University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (UIUC)
title_en: Visiting PhD period through the PDSE/CAPES program at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (UIUC)
summary_pt:
Entre setembro de 2025 e maio de 2026, realizei meu Doutorado Sanduíche pelo PDSE/CAPES na University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (UIUC), junto ao Department of Animal Sciences — ACES.

Sob a supervisão do Prof. Dr. Tiago Bresolin, integrei o iPhenogenomics — Illinois Phenomics and Genomics Research Group. Durante esses nove meses, aprofundei meus conhecimentos em imagens de profundidade, processamento digital de imagens, modelagem de dados e redes neurais aplicadas à produção animal.
summary_en:
From September 2025 to May 2026, I had the opportunity to complete my visiting PhD period through the PDSE/CAPES program at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (UIUC), within the Department of Animal Sciences — ACES.

Under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Tiago Bresolin, I joined the iPhenogenomics — Illinois Phenomics and Genomics Research Group. During these nine months, I expanded my knowledge of depth imaging, digital image processing, data modeling, and neural networks applied to animal production.
